Cancer surgeon, 45 years of experience

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Cancer surgery
  • Sarcoma
  • Cancer of the duodenum
  • Cancer of the gall bladder
  • Stomach cancer
  • Bowel cancer
  • Liver cancer
  • Cancer of the oesophagus
  • Pancreatic cancer
  • Rectal cancer

Summary:

Professor Joseph Klausner is a leading Israeli doctor and an expert in cancer surgery, specialising in operations to remove malignant tumours of the digestive tract. He currently holds the post of head of the gastrointestinal cancer surgery department at the Ichilov-Sourasky medical centre and chairs the international committee of the American society of surgical oncologists.

Principal procedures:

  • Gastric bypass
  • Colectomy
  • Pancreas transplantation
  • Sleeve gastrectomy
  • Liver resection
  • Oesophagectomy

Education and clinical experience:

Professor Klausner took his medical degree in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University. He specialised in surgery at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem. After completing his specialisation he returned to Tel Aviv University, where he became a senior lecturer in the department of medicine.

Professor Klausner later worked as a research fellow at Brigham and Women's Hospital, Harvard University, USA. On returning to Tel Aviv University he became a professor in the department of medicine and subsequently chairman of the department of surgery.

Academic and research work:

Professor Klausner is actively engaged in research and teaching. He has been a member of the Israel Medical Association since 2014. Over his career he has published many research papers and presented at international conferences and symposia.

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Society of Surgical Oncology, USA

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Endocrinologist
Main areas of specialisation:

  • Internal medicine
  • Endocrine disorders
  • Diabetes
  • Diseases of the thyroid gland
  • Diseases of the parathyroid gland
  • Osteoporosis
  • Metabolic disorders
  • Obesity

Summary:
Professor Louis Shenkman is a specialist of the highest class in internal medicine and endocrinology and an expert in metabolic disease. He is a leading physician in the endocrinology department of Assuta, Israel's largest clinic, with 40 years of clinical experience. He is one of the most sought-after endocrinologists in Israel.

Patients come to Professor Shenkman from all over the world with various endocrine disorders, diabetes, metabolic problems, obesity and malignant tumours of the endocrine system.

Louis Shenkman received an excellent education at New York University. After completing his studies he undertook a fellowship in endocrinology at the National Institutes of Health in the United States. From 1971 to 1981 he worked at the Bellevue Hospital Center in New York, and then until 2009 headed the department of general medicine at the Meir public medical complex in Israel.

Today Professor Shenkman works actively as a consultant in endocrinology and internal medicine. He teaches at the Weizmann Institute in Rehovot and at Tel Aviv University. He is also seriously engaged in research; his most recent interests concern the function of the hypothalamus and pituitary gland. He is the author of numerous research publications and monographs in leading specialist medical journals.

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, New York University, USA
  • Fellowship and research in endocrinology at the National Institutes of Health, USA

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Endocrine Society
  • Israel Diabetes Association
  • European Society of Endocrinology

Professor Michael Eldar
Specialisation: invasive cardiology

Main areas of specialisation:

Professor Michael Eldar is one of Israel's leading specialists in invasive cardiology. He currently holds the post of director of the Institute of Cardiology at the Sheba medical centre and has a private practice at the Assuta clinic. His professional interests cover a wide range of cardiac conditions and procedures, including:

  • Arrhythmia
  • Myocardial infarction
  • Angina
  • Fitting of pacemakers
  • Heart block
  • Cardiac ablation
  • Coronary artery bypass grafting
  • Atherosclerosis
  • Hypertension
  • High blood pressure
  • Stroke
  • Stenting
  • Thrombosis
  • Cancer of the heart

Education and clinical experience:

  • 1975: Graduated from the faculty of medicine, Technion, Haifa.
  • 1984: Completed specialisation in cardiology at the Heart Institute of the Sheba medical centre.
  • 1990: Fellowship in electrophysiology and pacemaker implantation at the University of California, San Francisco, USA.
  • 1991: Fellowship in invasive cardiology at Maimonides Medical Center (New York, USA).
  • 1994: Appointed head of the Neufeld Cardiac Research Institute at the Sheba medical centre.
  • 2001: Appointed head of the Institute of Cardiology at the Sheba medical centre.
  • 2012: Began private practice at the Assuta clinic.

Academic and research work:

Professor Michael Eldar is actively engaged in clinical and teaching work. He specialises in:

  • Therapeutic and diagnostic cardiac catheterisation.
  • Implantation of pacemakers and defibrillators.
  • Treatment of arrhythmia by ablation.

Professor Eldar also lectures to medical students at Tel Aviv University and heads the department of cardiology there. His research includes the publication of more than 100 papers on cardiology in international journals.

Membership of medical associations:

Professor Michael Eldar belongs to several professional societies, including the European Society of Cardiology. He is actively engaged in research and makes a significant contribution to the development of cardiology internationally.

Professor Michael Eldar is recognised for his contribution to invasive cardiology, thanks to which a great many patients have received medical care of the highest quality and improved their quality of life.

Specialisation: haematologist, haemato-oncologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Treatment of haematological and haemato-oncological disease in children and adults.
  • Use of immunotherapy in cancer treatment.
  • Bone marrow transplantation, including procedures for elderly patients.

Professional overview:

Professor Michael Shapira is a leading Israeli haematologist and haemato-oncologist who heads a department at the Institute of Haematology of the Assuta medical centre. With more than 35 years of clinical experience, Professor Shapira specialises in the diagnosis and treatment of blood disorders, including leukaemia, myeloma and myelodysplastic syndromes.

Clinical path:

  • Faculty of medicine: Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel.
  • Residency: Internal medicine at the Hadassah medical centre, Israel.
  • Fellowship: Haematology and bone marrow transplantation at the Hadassah medical centre, Israel.
  • Senior physician: Haematology department, Wolfson medical centre.

Academic and research achievements:

  • Teacher: Sackler School of Medicine, Tel Aviv University.
  • Publications: Author of research papers in international journals on haematology and internal medicine.
  • Symposia: Regular participation in Israeli and international conferences on haematology and oncology.

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association.
  • Israel Haematology Association.
  • Israel association of haemato-oncologists.

Professor Shapira is known for his international contribution to the development and application of innovative treatments for blood disorders, including bone marrow transplantation for elderly patients, which reflects his commitment to improving and extending his patients' lives through advanced medical technology.

Oncologist, breast specialist, surgeon
More than 40 years of clinical experience

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Cancer surgery
  • Treatment of breast cancer
  • Lumpectomy (partial removal of the breast)
  • Mastectomy (removal of the breast)
  • Breast reconstruction

Summary:

Professor Moshe Papa is an excellent breast surgeon, a specialist with enormous experience and the highest professionalism in breast surgery. He carries considerable authority among colleagues far beyond Israel.

In his daily practice Moshe Papa successfully applies the newest technologies and techniques for diagnosing breast cancer at the earliest stage. He uses the Tomosynthesis three-dimensional mammography system, which allows breast tissue to be examined in 3D. He uses the highly advanced MarginProbe device, which allows the edges of a tumour to be removed with great precision and considerably reduces the risk of repeat operations. He also actively promotes and uses the new technique of gentle targeted radiotherapy, Intrabeam. The Intrabeam system delivers radiation only to the area where the cancer is located, without damaging healthy tissue.

Professor Papa has thousands of successful operations and saved patients from all corners of the world to his name. His priority is organ-preserving surgery for breast tumours, in the knowledge of how important preserving the breast is to every woman. Where the breast cannot be preserved, he carries out reconstruction during the operation, fitting an implant at the same time. He performs such operations with masterly skill, preserving the best possible cosmetic and aesthetic appearance of the breast, which spares the patient a second period of distress.

The development of new techniques and operations in breast medicine and oncology has brought Moshe Papa international renown. The professor has many publications and takes an active part in many international medical societies. He passes his many years of experience and skill on to colleagues, trains younger specialists and lectures to medical students.

He is a member of the editorial board of the well-known medical journal Surgical Oncology.

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation in general surgery at Mount Sinai Hospital, New York, USA
  • Fellowship at the National Institutes of Health, USA
  • Specialisation in cancer surgery at the National Cancer Institute (NCI), USA
  • Fellowship in general surgery at the university clinic in Toronto, Canada

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Expert and ethics committee of the Israeli Ministry of Health
  • Secretary of the society for genetic technologies in oncology
  • Expert to the National Institutes of Health, USA

Endocrinologist
Experience: 48 years

Specialisation:

Professor Naftali Stern is an internationally known specialist in endocrinology with 48 years of experience. He heads the Institute of Endocrinology, Metabolism and Hypertension at the Ichilov medical centre and holds private consultations at the Assuta clinic.

The professor specialises in treating the following conditions:

  • Diabetes
  • Osteoporosis
  • Obesity
  • High blood pressure
  • Tumours of the pituitary gland
  • Autoimmune thyroiditis
  • Graves' disease
  • Atherosclerosis

Education and clinical experience:

  • 2014: Private practice at the Assuta clinic
  • 1988: Appointed head of the Institute of Endocrinology, Metabolism and Hypertension at the Ichilov clinic
  • 1984: Became head of the Riverside obesity treatment clinic (California, USA)
  • 1983: Began work as a physician in the endocrinology department of the University of California clinic, where he immediately took charge of the diabetes units
  • 1983: Completed specialisation in endocrinology at the University of California, USA
  • 1981: Completed specialisation in internal medicine at the Sheba clinic
  • 1975: Graduated from the faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University

Academic and research work:

Professor Stern is a well-known scientist and researcher. At various times he has held leading positions in several international societies and served on the editorial boards of journals such as Endocrinology, Diabetes and the American Journal of Physiology. Naftali Stern is also a professor in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University and an associate professor at the University of California medical school, USA.

Membership of medical associations:

  • The Endocrine Society, USA
  • International Society of Hypertension
  • American Society of Hypertension
  • Council on Hypertension of the American Heart Association
  • Israel Diabetes Association
  • Israel Endocrine Society
  • Israel Society of Hypertension (former president)
